newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's economic performance index up 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel's economic performance index up 0.4 pct.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index rose 0.4 percent in September, the Bank of Israel said.

The "S" index is made up of three components: retail sales, which rose 1.9 percent in September after increasing 1.1 percent in August; imports, which rose 11.5 percent in September after falling 10 percent in August; and industrial production, which was unchanged in August after falling 0.7 percent in July.
Note: figures for industrial production lag by a month.
In the first nine months of the year the index rose 3.7 percent against a 7.6 percent rise in the same period last year.
The central bank said the latest figures indicate continued stability in economic activity.
